description:
Send a text message to an Instagram user.

Meta allows this only within 24 hours of that user's last message to the account. Outside the window, set tag="HUMAN_AGENT" to use the 7-day human-agent allowance; unsolicited messages are not possible at all.

Requires the messaging permission with Advanced Access. Get the recipient IGSID from instagram_list_conversations — a public username will not work.

account_id.description: Sending account ID; omit for the token's own

recipient_id.description: Instagram-scoped user ID (IGSID) of the recipient. Get it from instagram_list_conversations participants or from a messaging webhook — a public @username will not work.

tag.description: Set HUMAN_AGENT to reply up to 7 days out, when a human is handling the thread

name: instagram_send_message
title: Send Direct Message
